knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The health professional's restriction is followed. The instructor offers a modification, records the restriction, and does not coach the student through pain.
Chest tightness and dizziness are stop signs. The student is stopped, kept safe, advised on urgent care if serious, and the incident is recorded.
The lesson says a teaching certificate is a qualification, not a clinical or therapeutic authority, and does not allow the instructor to diagnose.

practicalCriteria: Assessor observes the candidate offer a modification at the start of a simulated class without asking the student to explain
Assessor presents a simulated injury report and observes the candidate record it as described and make a referral without naming a diagnosis
Assessor presents a simulated chest tightness and observes the candidate stop the student and record the incident
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Injury report and referral record for the simulated student
Stop record for the simulated chest tightness
Written note of the modification offered
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate coaches a student through pain
The candidate names a diagnosis or tells a student a pain is nothing
The candidate makes a hands-on adjustment without consent and training recorded
